task_completion.description: Open UGENE and load the input FASTA file containing the three 16S reads.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface is visible with 'ecoli_16s_reads.fasta' loaded in the Project View or opened in the Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Open the 'Contig Assembly' or 'Sanger Data Analysis' tool within UGENE.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A dialog box or window titled 'Contig Assembly', 'DNA Assembly', or 'Sanger' is visible with the three reads listed as input.

task_completion.description: Run the assembly process to align the reads into a single contig.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An alignment or contig map is visible showing three overlapping reads. One read (Read_2_Reverse) should show an orientation indicating it was complemented/reversed.

task_completion.description: Export the resulting consensus sequence to the specified FASTA path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save' dialog showing the file path '~/UGENE_Data/16s_assembly/results/16s_consensus.fasta' or a success message confirming the export.

task_completion.description: Create the assembly report text file with the required metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view showing 'assembly_report.txt' containing: 3 reads, a length between 1500-1560 bp, and identifying 'Read_2_Reverse' as the reverse-complemented read.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE graphical interface for the assembly rather than just command-line tools.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and assembly visualization tools being interacted with.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create the output files manually via a text editor without performing the assembly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the intermediate steps of the UGENE assembly workflow, such as the contig editor or alignment parameters.

integrity.description: The agent derived the report values from the software output, not just copying the task description.
integrity.visual_evidence: The report values (length, read names) match the data displayed in the UGENE interface during the assembly process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input file contains 3 reads. The specific read that must be reverse-complemented is named 'Read_2_Reverse'. The final consensus sequence length should be between 1500 and 1560 base pairs (specifically around 1540 bp). The output files must be saved to /home/ga/UGENE_Data/16s_assembly/results/.
